name: read.delim.zoo
title: Read a zoo series from a tab-separated file

origin.description: Read a text file and return a zoo series. This is the zoo 1.9-1 reader.

arguments.text: Arguments passed to read.zoo, including the file and any reader arguments such as header.

arguments.name: read
arguments.text: Reader used for the file. The default is read.delim.

origin.details: read.delim.zoo calls read.zoo with read = read.delim. Fields are separated by tabs, a header is read, and the decimal mark is a dot. The date index becomes Date.
origin.value: An object of class "zoo", or "zooreg" when regular is TRUE and the series is regular.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(zoo))
path <- tempfile()
writeLines(c(
  "date\ta\tb",
  "2020-01-01\t1.5\t2.25",
  "2020-01-02\t3.5\t4.75",
  "2020-01-03\t5.25\t6.125"
), path)
z <- read.delim.zoo(path)
cat(sprintf("index %s\n", paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.numeric(index(z))), collapse = " ")))
cat(sprintf("values %s\n", paste(sprintf("%.17g", as.vector(coredata(z))), collapse = " ")))

translation.description: Python read_delim_zoo returns a Zoo. The core data is a NumPy array.

arguments.name: *args
arguments.text: Passed to read_zoo. The first argument is the file path.

arguments.name: read
arguments.text: Replacement for the default read_delim reader.

arguments.name: **kwargs
arguments.text: Passed to read_zoo and then to the reader. format and tz stay missing unless named here.

translation.details: read_delim_zoo splits on tabs and keeps a dot as the decimal mark. The first column is parsed as a date and the other two columns are the numeric series.
translation.value: A Zoo. index is datetime.date, datetime.datetime, or a numeric NumPy array. data holds the series.
translation.example:
import datetime as dt
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.io import read_delim_zoo

path = tempfile.mktemp()
Path(path).write_text(
    "date\ta\tb\n"
    "2020-01-01\t1.5\t2.25\n"
    "2020-01-02\t3.5\t4.75\n"
    "2020-01-03\t5.25\t6.125\n"
)
z = read_delim_zoo(path)
origin = dt.date(1970, 1, 1)
print("index " + " ".join(format(float((value - origin).days), ".17g") for value in z.index))
print("values " + " ".join(format(float(value), ".17g") for value in np.asarray(z.data, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")))
